patch_list: Adds Export & storage to Settings > Downloads in MySpoti 2.3.0 in both Classic and Immersive looks, matching MySpoti's Immersive glass, grouped surfaces and selected accent; includes local-first playback for downloaded tracks, tagged audio…
Renames MySpoti to Spotify and replaces every launcher, themed, supporter-preview, splash, widget, and notification mark with Spotify branding.
